items.title: Patients will meet adverts in ChatGPT
items.body: OpenAI says ChatGPT handles a fifth of Google's search volume and that users do not seem to mind adverts, so more are coming. Patients who look up symptoms there may see paid content beside the answer. It is worth asking where advice came from, as we already do with search results.

items.title: Metered AI needs a budget holder
items.body: Apple is cutting daily AI allowances per engineer. The lesson for a practice or PCN is that usage-priced tools need someone watching the bill. NLW sees ordinary cost discipline; Zitron would say it shows the product costs more than its price. Either way, ask vendors for a fixed price or a cap.

items.title: Drug discovery money, not yet medicines
items.body: Isomorphic Labs is reported to be raising five billion dollars at a fifty billion valuation. That is investor confidence in AI-assisted drug discovery, not evidence of benefit. Nothing reaches a formulary without trials, so there is no change for prescribing. Otherwise this edition has little healthcare relevance.
